summary: Blocked by headless runtime/display constraints. The exact requested cafeteria realistic live flashlight command was launched in tmux, but the packaged Unreal standalone crashed during RHI initialization before RPC startup, map-load confirmation, startup warmup, or initial teleop logs. The log shows missing DISPLAY/WAYLAND_DISPLAY, zenity cannot open display, SIGSEGV in SDL/Wayland_ShowMessageBox, then SPEAR reports the Unreal process as zombie and exits with AssertionError.
work_completed: Launched the exact requested command in tmux session `realistic_live_flashlight_174220`, window `runtime`. Attach command during execution: `tmux attach -t realistic_live_flashlight_174220`. The session auto-closed after the crash.

Exact command used: `cd /home/yashturkar/Workspace/spear && conda activate spear-env && python examples/flashlight/run.py --map cafeteria_500sqft_v2 --live-lighting-mode realistic --flashlight-profile realistic_live_flashlight --scene-light-intensity-scale 0.0005 --movement-speed 600 --disable-auto-exposure --startup-warmup-seconds 3`
Preserved durable runner, manifest, status, blocker summary, runtime log, and exit status under the run directory.

Confirmed from generated SPEAR config in the log that GAME_DEFAULT_MAP was set to `/Game/SPEAR/Scenes/cafeteria_500sqft_v2/Maps/cafeteria_500sqft_v2`, launch INI local-exposure suppression was present, and realistic Lumen GI/reflection INI retention was present before the crash.

findings.message: Runtime validation did not reach map load, startup warmup, or teleop. Unreal crashed during RHI initialization with `LogRHI: Warning: Could not detect DISPLAY or WAYLAND_DISPLAY environment variables`, `zenity: cannot open display`, `Signal 11 caught`, and stack frames including `Wayland_ShowMessageBox` and `PlatformCreateDynamicRHI`.

SPEAR could not connect to the RPC server after the Unreal process became zombie: log lines include `ERROR: Unrecognized process status: zombie`, `ERROR: Couldn't connect to RPC server, giving up`, and Python `AssertionError`; runner exit status was 1.

Launch-time config evidence is present: `r.DefaultFeature.AutoExposure=False`, `r.EyeAdaptationQuality=0`, `r.DefaultFeature.LocalExposure.HighlightContrastScale=0`, `r.DefaultFeature.LocalExposure.ShadowContrastScale=0`, `r.DynamicGlobalIlluminationMethod=1`, `r.ReflectionMethod=1`, `r.Lumen.DiffuseIndirect.Allow=1`, and `r.Lumen.Reflections.Allow=1` were written into the generated SPEAR config before the crash.

Runtime console-command application was not reached, so `Exposure/local exposure runtime config`, realistic renderer retention logs, inverse-square control logs, shadow/contact-shadow state logs, `Startup warmup before live control`, and `Live flashlight control begins` could not be validated.
The map path was configured as GAME_DEFAULT_MAP, but there is no successful map-load confirmation in this run because the process crashed before RPC/world initialization.

follow_up_recommendations: Rerun the same exact command from an environment with a working DISPLAY or WAYLAND_DISPLAY attached to the NVIDIA runtime.

If live validation must run from this headless shell, request Builder to add or expose a supported render-offscreen/headless runtime option for `examples/flashlight/run.py`, then rerun Experimenter validation in tmux with durable logs.

After the display/runtime blocker is resolved, verify the required log markers: map load, local exposure runtime suppression, realistic Lumen/reflection/material retention, inverse-square state, shadow/contact-shadow state, warmup completion, and initial teleop start.
